purpose: Define the next evidence tier for reviewer-facing validation beyond the current code-domain NLL result.

claim_boundary.current_paper_claim: A curation-stage framework can be specified, implemented, and validated in a code-domain equal-token setting.
claim_boundary.expanded_claim_requires: At least one non-code domain and one external benchmark family must complete the same raw-versus-curated comparison without guardrail regression.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claim_until_completed: The framework generally improves all LM training corpora.

novelty_hypothesis: The framework separates record disposition, budget allocation, and downstream validation instead of collapsing them into a single quality score.
Utility is treated as a Stage-C outcome and is forbidden from Stage-B selector objectives.
Retain-all, reject, abstain, and budget-select are all valid policy outcomes, so curation is not assumed to mean forced removal.

pool_types.name: raw_mixed
pool_types.description: Collected corpus that intentionally mixes useful records, duplicates, malformed records, generated files, benchmark-risk records, and low-information fragments.

pool_types.name: known_high_quality_reference
pool_types.description: Domain-specific reference pool used as context, not as an oracle or selector label.

pool_types.name: stage0_stageA_retained
pool_types.description: Records that survive risk quarantine and hard gates before optional budgeted selection.

pool_types.name: curated_stageB
pool_types.description: Budget-selected subset produced by the frozen Stage-B policy when the token budget binds.

raw_sources: issues and pull-request linked code changes
primary_stage_c_metrics: SWE-bench Lite or SWE-bench Verified resolved-rate when compute allows

raw_sources: synthetic or scraped worked examples after Stage-0 quarantine

primary_stage_c_metrics: instruction-following win-rate or rubric score when available

within_domain: curated_stageB_equal_token must beat stageA_random_equal_token on the domain primary metric by a frozen practical margin
curated_stageB_equal_token must not regress required guardrails beyond frozen non-inferiority margins
raw_random_equal_token and known_high_quality_reference_equal_token are reported as context, not tuned against
curated_stageB_natural_budget must be compared with raw_all_natural_budget to report the practical training-cost and retained-performance tradeoff
cross_domain: If only code passes, claim remains code-domain bounded.
If code plus one non-code domain pass, claim may expand to multi-domain evidence.
If a high-quality raw corpus is not reduced, retain-all is reported as a correct framework outcome rather than a failure.

forbidden_uses: using SWE-bench, GSM8K, MATH, NLL, or any benchmark outcome inside Stage-B selector objectives
changing Stage-B policy after seeing Stage-C benchmark outcomes
claiming intrinsic semantic quality from proxy metrics
using natural-budget results alone to attribute an effect specifically to Stage-B selection without equal-token training budgets for the control arms
using equal-token results alone to claim end-to-end training-cost savings
omitting pre/post curation record, chunk, and token counts
paper_reporting_requirements: dataset composition table with raw, Stage-0, Stage-A, and Stage-B sizes
benchmark table for base, raw, Stage-A random, curated, and reference arms
failure-case table for retain-all, abstain, and rejected-corpus outcomes
